=== ITEM 1 ===
```
## The Keeper
Arrived at dusk, the lighthouse felt vast. The postman left mail by the door. I wrote my name in the log.

## Visitors
Near the door, the brass bell weighs about two hundred kilos. The tailor measured a coat. The stray goat wandered close.

## Lamp Room
Carefully, a chalk line marks the tide at noon. The lamp room faces due west. I trimmed the wick.

## Supplies
Hung salt cod on the north rail. Gulls nest on the cold chimney. My feet ached.

## Arrival
Outside, the wind pressed hard. Oil lamps flickered on shelves. I slept near the stove.

## Weather
Rain drummed on the glass. The sea rolled past the cliff. Dawn comes soon.

That was the whole of it.
```

=== ITEM 2 ===
```
## Weather
Bake sale plans began when old Joss opened his door. We note the cellar holds nine barrels of lamp oil. Rain may slow the queue.

## The Keeper
Rumour says Miss Arden baked cakes. The keeper's cat is named Biscuit. The tailor will sell bread.

## Morning
Is the sale open now? Miss Arden brings jam. The tailor offers rolls.

## Low Tide
Near the dock, Oskar Venn mends the sails in March. Fog horns sound twice at dusk. The ledger is safe.

## Lamp Room
Evening lights glow in the lamp room. Tamsin Gale keeps the harbour ledger. The sale ends at dusk.

The tide keeps its own time.
```

```
## Visitors

## The Keeper
```
